## Brief
Phase 3 of the 0.13.4 release: fix the Windows build's asar checks in .github/workflows/release.yml, so the Windows artifacts can be produced by re-dispatching the workflow on the release branch. Work in the BadTakes main checkout (/Users/ericlugo/Personal/BadTakes) on branch chore/release-0.13.4. Tag v0.13.4 and the published creator kit stay as they are.

What BADS-005/Amandine found: release.yml run 34900857113 (tag v0.13.4) failed at "Verify the bundled faces reached the asar", a step added in #303 and running on Windows for the first time. The fonts were in the bundle, but `asar list` prints backslash-separated paths on Windows, and the check greps for forward slashes, so it can never pass there. The older server/ and site/ leak check in the same workflow has the same blind spot: on Windows it can never find a leak, so it passes vacuously. Read `spud member show BADS-005/Amandine` for her full account.

Do:
1. Read .github/workflows/release.yml, and `gh run view 34900857113 --log-failed` for the exact failing command and output.
2. Fix both checks so they compare separator-normalized paths: the fonts check must find the faces, and the leak check must actually catch server/, site/ and voicepacks/ entries on Windows. Keep the shell the steps already use. Change nothing else in the workflow.
3. Prove it locally without a Windows runner. Take the real `asar list` output of the built macOS app.asar in dist/, convert it to backslash form the way Windows prints it, and run each fixed check's logic against it: the fonts check passes, and the leak check fails when a synthetic `\server\x` or `\site\x` line is added and passes without one. Run the same checks against the forward-slash form too, so macOS and Linux behaviour is unchanged. Record the commands and outputs.
4. If a test in test/ pins release.yml's steps, update or extend it. Run `SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1 npm test` and record the totals.

Then `member result` with the diff summary and proof, and `member block` asking Spud to commit .github/workflows/release.yml (plus any test file) on chore/release-0.13.4, push, and run `gh workflow run release.yml -R 0snug0/BadTakes --ref chore/release-0.13.4`.

Never commit, push, tag, dispatch a workflow, publish or upload. Do not touch dist/ except to read the built app.asar. Do not use the Browser pane.
